evidence_limitations: This PASS is source-only. No actual dataset/cache/checkpoint, neural/GPU execution or SSH was performed in this review. It does not prove that all979 real videos have eligible GT, that any job launched, or that any new collection completed.
Actual CPU preparation must pass without dropping names; completed881/98 cache artifacts still require the planned independent actual-GT/history/schema/coverage CPU gate before training.

The same checkpoint is wired for prefix and future collection. Using that checkpoint for subsequent training initialization remains the plan's obligation; the preparer's init_same_as_prefix_and_future_teacher flag is not evidence of an executed training initialization.

Existing M0/FULL receipts establish historical completed training and schema evidence only. They do not establish new full-video fit completion, runtime memory behavior, new gradients or native metrics.

Teacher selection and later validation reuse developer-VAL information. These are development results, not independent benchmark results. All native/full-metric goals remain unmet by this source review.
